help_text:
Minecraft iOS Ore UI Auto Patcher

Features:
  • Unchecked "inject dylibs": remove Ore UI only, output _No_oreui.ipa
  • Checked "inject dylibs": remove Ore UI and inject 3 dylibs, output _No_oreui_all.ipa

Usage:
  1. Drop .ipa files anywhere in the window, or use "Add Files";
  2. Choose whether to inject dylibs;
  3. Optionally choose an output folder;
  4. Click "Start" and check the log below.

Notes:
  • The original IPA is never overwritten; new IPA must be re-signed.
  • Injection requires zsign.exe and 3 dylibs in this folder.
  • Drag & drop requires tkinterdnd2: pip install tkinterdnd2
  • Modifying game binaries may violate the terms of use; for study only.
